When Legendary Crafting was introduced, the devs opted not to provide a legendary version of this infamously powerful weapon, reasoning that it would render every other legendary martial weapon completely obsolete. Instead, this cosmetic version has a unique appearance based on early Vault of Night concept art.

'''Again, to stress:''' the Legendary version of this item is cosmetic only, and you will '''no longer be able to use it''' as a main hand weapon. Keep the item at Epic if you want to actually attack anything with it.
